Run a TIGHT, timeboxed QA session for story 832 "Manage clients and properties with access details" in /Users/johndavenport/Documents/github/cleaner_crm. Three prior agents died mid-run without submitting — your #1 priority is SUBMITTING A RESULT. Partial is acceptable; an unsubmitted perfect run is worthless.

Procedure:
1. Call mcp start_task (requirement_name="qa_complete", entity_type="story", entity_id="832").
2. Reuse the brief at .code_my_spec/qa/832/brief.md — do NOT rewrite it.
3. Execute ONLY these 4 core scenarios in the browser (skip everything else, including the /field propagation checks — they're covered by story 841's QA):

   c. Edit the property's lockbox code — verify change saves and an audit entry appears at /audit.

4. IMMEDIATELY submit_qa_result (pass if all 4 verified, partial otherwise, listing per-scenario observations + the prior agent's verified 7107).
5. Message me the verdict.

App facts: http://127.0.0.1:4100 ONLY; never start a server (message me on persistent 500s). Owner login qa-owner@cleanercrm.test / "qa password 1234" via /users/log-in password form. Browser is exclusively yours; close stale tabs first. Selects that don't fire phx-change: browser_evaluate set .value + dispatch input/change events. File real defects via create_issue. Do not edit app code. Do not exceed ~30 browser actions before submitting whatever you have.
</teammate-message>
